children: South Korea's exports for the first 20 days of this month hit a record on a surge in chip sales, customs data showed on Monday.
Exports rose 78.3% from a year earlier to $71.4 billion, the highest 20-day performance on record, as semiconductor shipments increased 259.4%.
On average each working day, exports were up 89.8%.
